summary: Flutter's prejoin voice header now matches the web reference across roster loading, unavailable, empty and populated states. A test-first widget regression failed on the old static invitation copy and passes after the change. Device screen-reader/focus acceptance remains open.

checks.name: Test-first prejoin header state regression
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name "announces prejoin roster loading and errors as live status"
checks.observation: Before implementation, the new assertion failed because Flutter showed the static `подключитесь, чтобы увидеть участников` subtitle instead of the web-equivalent loading string. After implementation, one widget test passes across loading, error, empty, and populated roster states.

checks.name: Full Flutter suite and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub && flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: All 326 Flutter tests pass and analyzer reports no issues.
